stem.assessmentliteracy.search_by_title_: Search by title, skill, or task (e.g., "patient", "data", "welding")
stem.assessmentliteracy.tell_the_ai_abou: Tell the AI about your situation, constraints, what you care about, what's scared you off careers in the past, what you suspect you'd love...
stem.assessmentliteracy.write_your_answe: Write your answer here. Aim for 2-3 minutes when spoken aloud (roughly 300-500 words typed). Cover all four STAR elements.
stem.assessmentliteracy.summarize_the_ev: Summarize the eval findings in professional terms. Examples: "Strong verbal reasoning (VCI 118). Below-average phonological processing (CTOPP-2 SS 78). Age-appropriate math achievement. Teacher reports classroom struggle with reading passages but strong oral participation."
stem.assessmentliteracy.e_g_sld_in_basic: e.g., "SLD in basic reading skills (dyslexia profile)"
stem.assessmentliteracy.e_g_tier_3_syste: e.g., "Tier 3 systematic phonics intervention 30 min/day 5x/week (Wilson or similar). Extended time on reading tasks. Weekly DIBELS ORF progress monitoring. Consider co-occurring anxiety screening given avoidance behaviors."
